Priya Patel: Quick async check — Q2 OKR milestone triage for runtime v3 latency project. Please post one-liners: shipped / slipped / blocking + owner. I'll compile and ping leads by EOD.
Alice Chen: Shipped: prefix-KV cache PR merged and deployed yesterday. Owner: me. No perf regressions seen. :thumbsup:
Marco Ruiz: Slipped: adaptive-batching heuristics—still failing on long-tail 8k seqs. Owner: me + eng-runtime. Blocker: perf test infra flaky.
Jenna O'Neal: Blocking: dedicated capacity autoscale bug causing burst drops. Owner: Jenna. Mitigation: scaled reserve to 30% until fix. Filing CR now: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-3245
Samir Khatri: Shipped: rollout for tracing hooks to console. Owner: Samir. Observability gaps noted but not blocking.
Priya Patel: Thanks. Marco, what's ETA on infra flakiness? Do you need help from infra or SRE?
Marco Ruiz: ETA 3 days if SRE helps repro. Requesting eng-infra to allocate time. Notes: failing when qps spikes >1200 for 10s.
Jenna O'Neal: For autoscale bug, repro steps in the ticket. Short-term rollback command:
```
./deploy rollback --service=autoscale-controller --to=2026-03-10T22:00Z
```
Use with caution, will drop burst capacity.
Alice Chen: Noted. I'll add a quick unit/regression test for the KV cache to prevent slips.
Priya Patel: Can everyone add a 1-line next-step and PR/ticket link by EOD? I'll synthesize for the exec roundtable. Also adding @eng-infra and @sre to follow up.
deploy-bot: Reminder: weekly standup summary posted in #product-wins at 6123456800
Samir Khatri: Next step: instrument extra latency buckets + open PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/598
Marco Ruiz: Next step: pair with SRE; ticket ENG-3301 created.
Jenna O'Neal: Next step: hotfix PR in progress -> https://github.com/redwood/autoscale/pull/112
Priya Patel: Perfect. Will compile and share summary. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
